title: Spinning Loading Border for Loadable Ui Elements
description: Add a uniform loading indicator across the UI: every loadable element (tree items/sections, action buttons, windows, skeleton placeholders) should show a border that spins clockwise with a pulsing motion, in the element's normal border color — gray when unselected, active color when selected/active. Implement in the React component library (ui/js/react/index.tsx + ui/styling/js/ui.css), remove the now-redundant chevron-slot Spinner on tree rows, and mirror the same loading concept + animated border into the wgpu UI (ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs + framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs) by adding a `loading` field to the shared UiNode schema and rendering an animated rounded-border ring via a new WGSL shader path driven by elapsed time.
